The class becomes `@Source abstract class` without its suffix constructor parameter. It keeps `override val name` (built from the display-name setting) and its preference-backed `override val baseUrl` over a placeholder static `baseUrl`, and gets its instance number from `INSTANCE_IDS.indexOf(id)`, a list that must follow the block order. `versionCode` is bumped. `fd44389f2f` (Keep some source FQN for app side reflection), now picked, then makes Komga a concrete `class Komga(override val lang: String, override val id: Long)`, which Jellyfin needs for Anikku's tracker; upstream adds a `-keepnames` rule so R8 keeps such a class's name, and Jellyfin's proguard-rules.pro already has one. Jellyfin maps directly: `JellyfinFactory` defaults to 3 sources, published as `Jellyfin (1)` to `Jellyfin (3)` with IDs 9033626646636195598, 4904658814710554862 and 7533223929553449342. Its ID key `jellyfin ($suffix)/all/2` equals the DSL's computed ID for `name = "Jellyfin (N)"` with `versionId = 2`, so set that or hard-code the IDs, and remove `override val versionId` and `override val id` from the class.; Plan 2026-10-30: StreamingCommunity moved to `source { }` blocks with `baseUrl { custom("https://streamingunity.fun") }` rather than its own `baseUrl` override: a redirected domain goes into the generated custom URL setting, and requests use the setting plus the language. `showType` comes from `name`, and `lang` and `id` come from the DSL, as planned. |
